name: b09 — GSTR-1 B2B grouping: two like lines merge, the head sum is not the group recompute
workings: A B2B invoice (buyer GSTIN carried in meta; e-invoicing is out of Phase 1, the two buyer columns are the whole provision). Two pharmacy lines of base 18875 at 1200 bps (heads 1133 each, net 21141 each) share a (sacCode, rateBps, exempt) key and merge into one row of base 37750 with cgst = sgst = 1133 + 1133 = 2266. Recomputing that row from its merged base would give taxHead(37750, 1200) = divHalfUp(45,300,000, 20,000) = floor((90,600,000 + 20,000) / 40,000) = floor(2265.5) = 2265 — one paise short, which is why the report layer must sum stored heads too. The device line (base 33333 at 500 bps, head 833, net 34999) keeps its own row. Invoice: gross = taxableBase = 2 x 18875 + 33333 = 71083; cgst = sgst = 2266 + 833 = 3099; rawTotal = 2 x 21141 + 34999 = 77281 = 71083 + 3099 + 3099. roundTotalToRupee(77281) = floor((154,562 + 100) / 200) x 100 = floor(773.31) x 100 = 77300, rounding +19.
